verdict.rationale: BigQuery documents an official `bq` CLI for creating datasets and querying tables, ODBC/JDBC drivers that connect applications, and Apache Arrow result retrieval for reading results back programmatically. Governance comes from IAM predefined roles and granular permissions on datasets, tables, views and routines, plus per-project or per-user custom quotas on processed data. The MCP Toolbox for Databases also gives agents a dashboard-free path. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of non-interactive authentication (e.g., service-account auth for the CLI/API), explicit schema-discovery commands or metadata APIs, and any hands-on or independent corroboration of an agent running the full flow.
